shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/UserProfile.tsx && printf '\\n--- ProductList ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductList.tsx"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- full file list ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -250"
/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff -- app/UserProfile.tsx tsconfig.json && nl -ba app/UserProfile.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- package.json && cat next-env.d.ts && git status --short --untracked-files=all | head -100'
/bin/bash -c 'git clean -fd -- .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json app/UserProfile.tsx'
